problem_type: Storyboard writes lose selected design identity across proposal admission
symptom: UI anchor replacement creates another same-title design; later patch edits the older selected design.
direct_cause: Proposal transaction drops existing documentId/storyboardId arguments; absent storyboardId forces new design creation.
class_root: Canvas write admission binds canvas nodes but omits the storyboard business target and its content revision.
affected_population: Creation and generation Agent storyboard writes
entry_points: Project renderer canvas.write capture and execute
internal_only_reason: Official Claude, pi and DeepSeek tool-result contracts establish truthful result correlation (plan prior-art section); selected Nomi storyboard identity is an internal domain invariant.
invariants: An approved storyboard mutation remains bound to its captured document, design and content.
Replace and patch update the selected design without silently creating another; explicit new-design UI remains unchanged.
generality_proof: Both resident Agent and MCP use canvas.write capture/admission/execute; the same evidence hash detects selected document/design/content changes, and the transaction receives the validated target rather than resolving mutable selection again.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Hash storyboard identity/content into approval preconditions.
Capture and validate the storyboard target before passing it to proposal execution.
Carry captured domain identity across asynchronous receipt preparation.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: canvas.write operations including propose and patch share renderer capture and execute.
Project-level callbacks use captureCanvasWriteRawEvidence and executeCanvasWriteTarget for both surfaces and MCP.

recurrence.reason: Every replacement without a bound design can append and misdirect later patches, regardless of supplier or surface.
same_class_scan: rg propose_storyboard_plan/patch_shots across laneDesktopTools, canvasModelTools, canvasWriteTarget, proposalTxn and applyCanvasToolCall
Checked direct planner with explicit documentId/no storyboardId: intentionally creates a new design; preserved existing test.

prevention.invariant: Storyboard target and content used to approve equal the ones admitted to execution.
prevention.failure_mode: Target/content drift fails capability_target_stale before mutation; invalid evidence fails capability_input_invalid.
prevention.strategy: Bind the non-canvas business object in shared canvas.write evidence, then pass its identity through the transaction.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed implicit active-state resolution from admitted storyboard proposal execution; explicit new-design direct API remains domain-owned.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No SDK replacement or upgrade can restore missing application-owned storyboard identity. pi 0.85.1 tool result format remains unchanged.

migration: No disk migration. Existing duplicates are preserved as user data. Fresh approvals capture current selected design; stale approvals must be reissued.
residual_risks: Model may clarify ambiguous replacement requests; do not count clarification as a save.
Media catalog availability is separate and no certification that generates media is authorized.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Shared renderer capture and execute see canonical storyboard store and enforce admission before any write.
